recipe.precisionJustification: PLANNED COVERAGE, NOT OBSERVED DATA. This layer is the planned High Latitude Wide Area Survey Medium tier (F158 and grism maps), derived by Assets from STScI pre-generated healsparse exposure-time maps in spacetelescope/roman_notebooks (pinned commit cb3ec341a1ff, APT program 1400, whose status may be Draft). The union of every pixel with a finite value above zero in 2 input map(s) (nside_sparse 4096, NESTED) is stored as a MOC at order 12; decoded area 2871.80 deg2 in 39692 cells. The STScI-published figure is Medium tier about 2415 deg2; the map-derived area (2871.80 deg2) is larger and the cause of the difference is not confirmed. The roll angle of the pre-generated maps may not match on-orbit exposures. No Roman survey data exist yet, so there are no files to look up; this is a planned extent, not a per-band valid-pixel mask or an observed footprint.
recipe.sourceEncoding: Derived NUNIQ MOC pinned in the repository; normalize without changing cells

limitations: Planned coverage, not observed data: Roman has not yet carried out this survey, so no files exist for this layer.
Derived from STScI roman_notebooks pre-generated maps for APT program 1400 (status may be Draft); the roll angle of the maps may not represent on-orbit exposures.
Map-derived area 2871.80 deg2 (39692 cells at orders 7-12). Medium tier officially about 2415 deg2; the difference is unexplained.
The MOC is rewritten from the upstream MOC 2.0 RANGE encoding to NUNIQ without changing cells; STScI publishes no MOC, so this derived MOC is not an official STScI product.
